buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Purchase Preference (State) Bid reserved for MSE from the State of Bid Inviting Authority: Procurement under this bid is reserved for purchase from Micro and Small Enterprises from the State of Bid Inviting Authority having valid Udyam Registration and whose credentials are validated online through Udyam Registration portal. If the bidder wants to avail themselves of the reservation benefit, the bidder must be the manufacturer / OEM of the offered product on GeM. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises and hence resellers offering products manufactured by some other OEM are not eligible to participate in this bid. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service, and Buyer will decide eligibility based on documentary evidence submitted, while evaluating the bid. Benefits of MSE will be allowed only if seller is validated on-line in GeM profile as well as validated and approved by Buyer after evaluation of documents submitted. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Display Board Size: 6 ft × 4 ft, made of stainless steel. 2. Supporting Poles: Two poles of 12 ft height each, including necessary fo undation, fixing and structural support. 3. Printing: Texts for Double-sided printing (both sides) shall be provided by the Department. The contractor shall undertake proper fixing/installation o f the Department-provided text and prints on both sides of each board. 4. Installation: The rate shall be inclusive of fabrication, transportation, labo ur, foundation, erection, installation and all incidental charges. Installation locations shall be throughout the jurisdiction of the Wildlife Warden, Kargil, as directed by the Department. 5. Quality and Safety: The boards and poles shall be of durable quality, sec urely installed and capable of withstanding local weather conditions. The c ontractor shall be responsible for the safety and stability of the installed str uctures. 6. Payment: Payment shall be made as per actual quantity installed and dul y verified by the Department, subject to the terms of the work order. 7. Legal Jurisdiction: Any dispute arising out of or in connection with the te nder or its execution shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the competent c ourts at Kargil, Union Territory of Ladakh. .
